name: Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd.
summary: Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture and sales of automotive interior and exterior parts and components in China. the company offers seats, dashboards, door panels, bumpers, headlights, steel wheels, rearview mirrors, and stamping parts. It is also involved in automobile parts wholesale; automobile parts retail; general cargo warehouse storage services; labor services; machinery and equipment leasing; non-residential real estate leasing; technical services, technology development, technical consulting, technical exchanges, technology transfer, and technology promotion; motor vehicle repair and maintenance; mechanical parts and components processing; metal cutting processing services; sewage treatment and recycling; property management; domestic trade agency; import and export agency; import and export of goods; and research and development of auto parts. The company was formerly known as Changchun FAWAY Automobile Components Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd. in June 2025. Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Changchun, China.
